comment: src/web/app is browser code compiled by bun-plugin-svelte: tsc must not emit declarations for it, and it uses Svelte runes tsc does not know. scripts/build-web.ts is excluded for a different reason: bun-plugin-svelte@0.0.6 ships TypeScript source with no declarations, so tsc follows the import into node_modules and reports three errors inside the plugin under this project's exactOptionalPropertyTypes. Excluding the importing root is the only way to keep `tsc --noEmit` clean without relaxing a compiler option for the whole repository.
